bibl.title: Zenon Papyri and Others: Letters of C.C. Edgar to H.I. Bell, 1919–1935
bibl.seg: 146 160 Bell Harold Idris Edgar Campbell Cowan
Nikolaos Gonis & Anna Szajbély, Zenon Papyri and Others: Letters of C.C. Edgar to H.I. Bell, 1919-1935.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 5 (2024) §1-93.
bibl.note: 35 letters from C.C. Edgar to H.I. Bell, from 1919 to 1935, discussing among others readings in Zenon papyri in London and Cairo, but also Petrie papyri from the archive of Kleon and Theodoros.
